headline: Western Melee Deepens in Callum's Cape and Mooring County
war_summary: The western theatre remains locked in ferocious bloodletting, led by unrelenting struggles across Callum's Cape and Mooring County. Over the past two hours, Callum's Cape witnessed seven fresh strategic shifts alongside nearly twenty-eight hundred casualties, keeping the peninsula divided between four Warden strongholds and three Colonial garrisons after bitter skirmishing across Scouts Jest and Naofa. To the north-east, Mooring County proved equally merciless, tallying six base transitions and more than twenty-eight hundred combined dead as Colonial forces desperately defend a single surviving base against ten Warden positions. In stark contrast to the preceding hours, the sudden tempest in Godcrofts has abruptly ceased, yielding zero base incidents and negligible losses over the latest watch. Activity across Linn of Mercy, Weathered Expanse, and Stlican Shelf similarly stalled in terms of outright territory changes during the last two hours, though elevated casualties continue to mark their front lines. Meanwhile, the Nevish Line and Marban Hollow sectors remain largely quiet, with no renewed tactical movements reported.
